about_the_game:
About this demo

This trial version is a free trial of the third person shooter game 《Bloodplague Lockdown》, aimed at allowing players to experience the core battles and atmosphere settings in advance.

In the trial version, you will experience:

Part of the level content in the complete version, including approximately 30 minutes of game time

Two types of weapons that can be used

Multiple types of enemies (mainly zombies)

Core combat mechanism and basic operational experience

This trial version does not include the complete storyline and subsequent levels, which will be provided in the official version.

content_descriptors.notes: There are combat scenes in the game, including special effects such as explosions, strikes, and blood sprays, and some enemies may be accompanied by dismemberment effects when they die. The content is fictional and does not involve sexual assault/non consensual behavior, drug and alcohol abuse, or self harm.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 / Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 / Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12500 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 17 GB available space

short_description: In this third person action adventure inspired by classic survival horror games, you will play the role of an FBI agent and travel to a secret research base that has been sealed off for many years to investigate the source of the virus.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil
